init.description:
Rooms: {rooms}

Changes take effect after choosing **Save and exit**.

data.name: Room name
data.valve_boost_threshold: Valve boost threshold – this room (empty = global value)
data.valve_boost_delay: Valve boost wait – this room, minutes (empty = global value)
data.valve_release_margin: Valve release before target – this room (empty = global value)

data_description.name: E.g. Living room
data_description.valves: Valves of this room. The room target is the target set on the valve (highest one if several).
data_description.temperature_sensor: If set, heat demand is calculated from it instead of the valve's own reading. Falls back to the valves if unavailable.
data_description.valve_control: When the room thermometer says it is cold, the valve target is temporarily raised to the valve maximum (valve fully opens) and restored to the original value once the target is reached. Requires a temperature sensor.
data_description.valve_boost_threshold: Only relevant with automatic valve control. If empty, the value from Settings applies.
data_description.valve_boost_delay: How long the deviation must persist before boosting. 0 = immediately. If empty, the global value applies.
data_description.valve_release_margin: The valve gets its original target back this far before the target. Must be below the threshold. If empty, the global value applies.
data_description.valve_demand_link: When on, the room only calls the boiler when its valve is open (valve's own reading is below its target) or when the plugin is forcing it open. Avoids firing the boiler into closed valves for small deviations. Does not block heating if valve data is missing.
data_description.humidity_sensor: At high humidity the room target is raised slightly (see Settings).
data_description.window_sensors: While a window or door stays open longer than the delay, the room stops calling for heat and the valve boost is released. With several sensors, any open one counts.
data_description.window_open_delay: How long the window must stay open before the room reacts, so short airing changes nothing. 0 = immediately. If empty, the global value applies.

data_description.valve_boost_delay: How long the deviation must persist before boosting. 0 = immediately. If empty, the global value applies.
data_description.valve_release_margin: The valve gets its original target back this far before the target. Must be below the threshold. If empty, the global value applies.

data.boiler_on_temp: Boiler target when heating (0 = don't change)
data.valve_boost_threshold: Valve boost threshold – default (how far below target)
data.valve_dry_run: Valve control dry run (log only, no writes to valves)

data_description.hysteresis: A room calls for heat when this much below target, and keeps calling until the target is reached.
data_description.min_switch_time: Minimum time between boiler on/off switches.
data_description.boiler_on_temp: Target set on the boiler thermostat when heat is needed.
data_description.humidity_max_boost: Target rises gradually from 60% humidity and reaches this value at 80%. No boost for targets below 17 °C.
data_description.valve_boost_threshold: Default for all rooms, can be overridden per room. Automatic valve control only boosts when the room is at least this far below target. For smaller deviations the valve decides alone and the radiator's residual heat is usually enough. (Boiler demand still starts at the hysteresis.)
data_description.valve_boost_delay: The deviation must persist this long before boosting, giving the radiator's residual heat a chance to warm the room. If the deviation exceeds the threshold by 1 °C (e.g. you raised the target) there is no wait. 0 = immediately.
data_description.valve_release_margin: The valve gets its original target back this far before the room reaches the target, since the radiator's residual heat keeps warming the room (prevents overshoot). Must be smaller than the boost threshold.
data_description.stale_check_enabled: When on, a sensor that has not reported for the time below is treated as unavailable (the room falls back to the valve's own reading, valve boost stops, and a Repairs notice appears). Also applies to the outdoor sensor.
data_description.stale_hours: Battery sensors can freeze at their last value without becoming unavailable. Set this to at least twice the sensor's usual reporting interval, otherwise you get false alarms.
data_description.max_boost_enabled: When on, the valve boost is stopped after the maximum duration below (protects against an open window, a misplaced sensor or a frozen value).
data_description.max_boost_hours: After this long the valve gets its original target back, even if the room has not reached the target.
data_description.max_boost_rest_minutes: How long no new boost is started after reaching the maximum duration. The room reaching its target resets this.
data_description.window_open_delay: Default for all rooms: how long a window must stay open before heating for that room is paused. Shorter airing changes nothing.
data_description.valve_dry_run: When on, valve control only logs what it would do ([PRÓBAÜZEM] prefix) and changes nothing on the valves. Recommended for the first live test.
data_description.register_card: When on, the integration adds the card file to the dashboard resources (Settings → Dashboards → Resources) and keeps its version up to date, so it appears in the 'Add card' list (it never adds a card to a dashboard by itself). With YAML-mode dashboards you have to add the resource manually (see README). When off, the integration does not touch the resources.

summer.title: Summer mode
summer.description: In summer mode there is no heat demand and the boiler thermostat is switched off. It is active when the date is inside the summer period AND the outdoor 24h average is above the threshold. Without a sensor summer mode is disabled.

features.title: Features
features.description:
Every feature can be switched on or off separately.

**Events**: the integration fires `meross_boiler_sync_event` events (valve boost, window, stale sensor, short cycling) that you can use in automations; they also appear in the Home Assistant logbook.

**Boiler cycle monitoring**: counts boiler starts and flags short cycling.

**Protection**: when enabled, the boiler stays on / off for at least the given time, even if the rooms' demand changes in the meantime. This can delay heating, so it is off by default.

data.cycle_min_avg_on_minutes: Short cycling: lower limit of the average on-time (0 = not monitored)
data.boiler_min_on_minutes: Protection: keep the boiler on for at least
data.boiler_min_off_minutes: Protection: keep the boiler off for at least

data_description.cycle_max_starts_per_hour: If the boiler started this many times or more in the last hour, the Short cycling sensor turns on.
data_description.cycle_min_avg_on_minutes: If the average on-time of the last 2 hours (from at least 3 cycles) is shorter, it also reports.
data_description.cycle_protection_enabled: The boiler is not switched off / on again before the minimum time has passed. The Minimum switching time (Basic settings) still applies.

stale_room_temp.title: Room temperature sensor is not updating
stale_room_temp.description: The temperature sensor {sensor} of room {room} has not reported for over {hours} hours (its battery may be empty or it lost its connection). The room now uses the valves' own reading and automatic valve control is paused. This notice disappears once the sensor reports again.

stale_outdoor.title: Outdoor temperature sensor is not updating
stale_outdoor.description: The outdoor sensor {sensor} has not reported for over {hours} hours (its battery may be empty). Summer mode is switched off until it reports again, so heating stays allowed. This notice disappears once the sensor reports again.
